D1.text: The system utilizes two trust scores. The first, credential-derived, assesses verifiable credentials. The second, behaviour-derived, measures peer performance. Chain selection prioritizes the behaviour-derived score. Peer entries are enriched from a reputation store. Candidates are filtered based on block coverage and failed peers, with trust serving as a secondary sort. A peer with no credentials can rank first if it exhibits good uptime.

entailment.why: credential trust graph touches peer selection.

D2.text: Trust is determined by performance metrics, specifically availability, throughput, and latency, alongside a vocabulary of tiers. Chain selection prioritizes behaviour-derived trust, while credential-derived trust is used solely as a secondary sorting factor.

entailment.why: Credential trust graph touches peer selection.
